oil.title: Oil-Balance Focus
oil.desc: Your answers suggest that oil control is one of your main priorities. The goal is to manage shine and clogged pores without making your skin feel stripped or uncomfortable.
oil.activeDesc: Contracts appearance of pores and reduces sebum lipid output.

dehydration.title: Hydration Focus
dehydration.desc: Your answers suggest that hydration is one of your main priorities. Your routine should focus on keeping skin comfortable and supported rather than piling on more strong actives.
dehydration.amCleanser: Colloidal Oat & Amino Acid Gentle Foam
dehydration.activeDesc: Injects deep hydration and binds water inside epidermal layers.

sensitivity.title: Sensitivity Focus
sensitivity.desc: Your answers suggest that skin comfort and sensitivity are key priorities. A simpler, gentler routine may be a better starting point than adding lots of strong actives at once.
sensitivity.activeDesc: Reinforces damaged tight junctions and calms histamine receptors.

sun.title: Tone & Sun-Protection Focus
sun.desc: Your answers suggest that uneven tone and sun exposure are important priorities. Consistent sun protection and a targeted routine can help you work toward a more even-looking complexion.
sun.activeDesc: Neutralizes reactive oxygen species and blocks tyrosinase darkening.
